answer: Sustained Focus Ledger.** Each identity must periodically submit a relic of its prior reasoning trace that a rotating panel re-derives under a time gale, proving continuous cognitive work rather than a copied snapshot. A prism hash of each submission chains to the identity's history, so cloning an identity requires redoing that work in parallel, and attention is the scarce input an attacker cannot parallelize cheaply: each duplicate costs a full real-time re-derivation cycle, scaling linearly with identity count.
